name: Trip context grounding
description: Fixed-fact questions the orchestrator must answer by calling get_trip_context with the exact date, never from memory. Answers are deterministic (specs/01-trip-context.md), so both the tool trajectory and the final response are pinned.

parts.text: Where are we staying on the night of July 20, 2026? Are all three families together that night?

On the night of July 20, 2026 (day 3 of the trip), everyone stays at the WestGate KOA campground at 3305 Targhee Pass Highway, West Yellowstone, MT 59758. Yes — all three families (Family 1, Family 2, and Family 3, 12 people total) are together at the KOA that night. That morning the group checks out of the shared Airbnb in Driggs, ID and moves to West Yellowstone.
Are the families staying together on the night of July 23, 2026? Where is everyone sleeping?

No — the group splits on July 23, 2026 (day 6 of the trip). Family 1 camps at the West Glacier NP KOA (355 Halfmoon Flats Road, West Glacier, MT 59936), while Family 2 and Family 3 share an Airbnb in Kalispell, MT (147 Cyclone Drive, Kalispell, MT 59901), about 25–30 minutes away from the KOA. Plans for July 23–25 need to account for the two separate bases.
